name: iuh-exchange
description: IUH Campus Exchange Platform - Node.js Microservices

scripts.dev: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d redis zookeeper kafka elasticsearch && npm run dev:services
scripts.dev:local: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml --profile local-db up -d mongodb redis zookeeper kafka elasticsearch && npm run dev:services
scripts.dev:services: concurrently "npm run dev --workspace=packages/api-gateway" "npm run dev --workspace=packages/user-service" "npm run dev --workspace=packages/product-service" "npm run dev --workspace=packages/order-service" "npm run dev --workspace=packages/notification-service" "npm run dev --workspace=packages/chat-service" "npm run dev --workspace=packages/lost-found-service" "npm run dev --workspace=packages/ws-gateway"
scripts.dev:monitoring: docker compose --profile monitoring up -d && npm run dev
